output:
Implemented a single draggable split between Pages/Outline and Libraries in the left pane.

**`pane-split.ts`**
- Split math with 80px minimum per section when expanded
- Collapsed header heights for pages (40px) and libraries (32px)
- `readLeftPaneSplit` / `writeLeftPaneSplit` via `localStorage`
- Keyboard adjustment (Arrow Up/Down, Home/End)
- Toggle helpers for section chevrons

**`left-pane.tsx`**
- Pixel heights from `ResizeObserver` instead of `flex-[2]` / `flex-[3]`
- One horizontal divider (drag, double-click toggles Pages collapse, keyboard focusable)
- Chevrons on Pages and Libraries headers
- Removed extra `border-b` / `border-t` between the two main sections (divider is the only separator)

**`pane-split.test.ts`** — parse, clamp, collapse, and keyboard behavior

**`src/shared/i18n.ts`** — divider and collapse aria labels (EN/RU)

**Verification:** `npx tsc --noEmit` and 88 prototype tests pass.

**Changed paths:** `src/studio/prototype/pane-split.ts`, `src/studio/prototype/pane-split.test.ts`, `src/studio/prototype/left-pane.tsx`, `src/shared/i18n.ts`

- 2026-10-17T17:54 prototype-shell-pages: Prototype: split builder, Axure three-column shell, pages and outline, rulers, style bar. The prototype builder gets Axure's layout: pages and outline on the left over the libraries, Style/Properties/Notes on the right, rulers and a context style bar.
- 2026-10-17T17:50 prototype-axure-widgets: Prototype: full Axure-standard widget set incl. Flow shapes and Markup. The prototype palette has the full standard Axure widget set: Common, Dynamic, Forms, Menus and table, Content, Markup and Flow shapes.
- 2026-10-17T17:46 prototype-icons-library: Prototype: Icons library with searchable Hugeicons set. The prototype builder has an Icons library: thousands of searchable icons that go onto the canvas as Icon elements.

- 2026-10-17T17:25 prototype-toolbar: Prototype: icon toolbar with groups, tooltips, align tools, zoom menu and primary Send. The prototype builder has a compact, friendly icon toolbar like Axure instead of a row of text buttons.
- 2026-10-17T17:17 prototype-inline-edit: Prototype: inline editing on double click, Enter adds the next item or radio. The owner renames elements by double click right on the canvas and builds radio groups and lists by pressing Enter.
- 2026-10-17T17:07 prototype-palette-previews: Prototype palette: tile grid with live element previews. The prototype palette shows each element as a small visual preview tile with its name, like Axure's library panel.
- 2026-10-17T16:19 prototype-builder: Office Studio prototype builder: canvas, UI elements with badges, save and send to chat. In Office Studio the owner builds a UI prototype from ready elements with name badges, saves it in the chat's files and sends a screenshot and/or the JSON to the chat for the agent.
